de: American Revolutionary War: Colbert's Raid: A Spanish garrison under Captain Jacobo du Breuil defeat British irregulars at Arkansas Post.

te: The first instance of black slaves in the United States of America being counted as three-fifths of persons (for the pu…
dz: "三五"妥协:美国黑人奴隶在联邦国会的一项决议中被算作"五分之三"(为征税目的)的一审. 这后来被1787年宪法所采纳.
de: Three-Fifths Compromise: The first instance of black slaves in the United States of America being counted as three-fifths of persons (for the purpose of taxation), in a resolution of the Congress of the Confederation. This was later adopted in the 1787 Constitution.
